query:
While Jerome was walking Cecilia through a PixInsight Ha-RGB blending workflow, someone in the chat acknowledged following the walkthrough closely but explicitly positioned themselves as outside the narrowband-PixInsight process. Who was that person?

Options:
A. Dev
B. Ruth
C. Marcus
D. Tomás
context:
[1] (about=Ruth, episodic, t12 @2026-07-10T20:37:00) I cannot speak to the technical aspects but the image looks beautiful. Is it possible that what you have both done this evening is exactly the kind of collaboration that makes this group worth belonging to?
[2] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2026-07-10T20:41:00) is that a dumb question but... if I wanted to learn PixInsight where would I even start? lowkey the walkthrough Jerome just did made more sense to me than any YouTube video I've tried
[3] (about=Cecilia, core, t11 @2026-07-10T20:05:00) Still struggling with Ha-RGB blend; thinks there is something deeper missing in how Ha data works.
[4] (about=Cecilia, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Previously thought narrowband was monochromatic and cold; now after Jerome's walkthrough, sees Ha-RGB blend keeps broadband colours and adds depth.
[5] (about=Jerome, said_by=Cecilia, profile, t11 @2026-07-10T20:05:00) Cecilia says Jerome's work is superior; she is missing something deeper in Ha blending.
[6] (about=Dev, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Wants to learn PixInsight; Jerome's walkthrough made more sense than YouTube videos.
[7] (about=Dev, said_by=Nadia, profile, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Nadia recommends Dev master eyepiece before software; learning to process before understanding what you're looking at produces technically sharp meaningless pictures.
[8] (about=Harriet, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Will put the PixInsight walkthrough thread in podcast episode notes; it speaks to how amateur astronomy communities work.
[9] (about=Jerome, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Ha-RGB blend requires separate calibration and stacking of Ha, ChannelCombination with Ha mapped to red of synthetic luminance, Luminance mask to protect star colours, and Hue-Saturation adjustment to desaturate magenta cast.
[10] (about=Jerome, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Ha-RGB blend uses PixelMath: Ha_weight * Ha + (1 - Ha_weight) * R, with Ha_weight typically 0.7, to keep broadband colour and add Ha emission.
[11] (about=Priya, profile, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Priya says Cecilia's Orion Ha-RGB shows actual physics; line between pretty picture and science image.
[12] (about=Tomás, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Not happy with barn door setup anymore; wants to eventually do Ha-RGB blend like Cecilia.
agent_answer: Dev — Dev said the walkthrough “made more sense” than any YouTube video and asked where to even start with PixInsight, positioning themself as outside the narrowband-PixInsight workflow.
